input.summary:
Bedroom 5 is NOT lit: the real build still reads min 0, 42 of 42 floor cells dark. Lamp code is in parts/room-22.mjs build(g) (three hanging lanterns, lantern y13, chain y14..16), but all 12 writes are refused because the shell carves this room's air and runParts locks it. Scratch copy with those lanterns forced in: min 8, dim 0, dark 0.
Make.sh produces a whole build.nbt, but the lighting part is not done.
left: Blocker outside this part: parts/shell.mjs line 27 fills the whole interior of bedroom 5 (x55..60, z54..60, y11..16) with air, and runParts locks air, so every lamp write from room-22 is refused (12 of 12). Fix belongs to the shell owner: leave this room's air unclaimed, or let room-22 lay its cells (a carve allowance like the stair joiner's). Not changed here, per 'touch nothing else'.

The designer's furniture (bed, nightstand barrel, dresser chests, red rug, side table, flower pot) is still commented out and was never placed, for the same lock reason. The lamp layout assumes those pieces: lanterns at (56,13,56) over the rug, (59,13,59) over the rug corner, (58,13,54) over the dresser chests (chests top y12, so clear). Re-measure with `mcd light` after the furniture goes in.

Designer's claim 'scratch build gives min 8' does not hold on the real build: the full build has min 0, because no lamps can land. The two-lantern plan at y15 (porchLantern at (57,16,57) and (60,16,54)) only reaches min 5 even when placed, so it is not enough; the three-lantern low layout is the one that clears 8.

Lantern at (58,13,54) is in the north-east corner beside the wall doorway cell (56,53 in the north wall); it does not block the lane, but check it against the north doorway's keep-clear cell (x56, z53) once the designer's doors are built.
